def digitSum(s):
    if s == "":
        return 0
    return sum(ord(char) if char.isupper() else 0 for char in s)


# Unit test for function digitSum
def test_digitSum():
    assert digitSum("") == 0
    assert digitSum("abc") == 0
    assert digitSum("A") == 65
    assert digitSum("ABC") == 65 + 66 + 67
    assert digitSum("aBcD") == 66 + 68
    assert digitSum("A1!Z") == 65 + 90
